What to Expect

In this role as Inside Sales Supervisor, you will lead and manage a dynamic inside sales team while ensuring exceptional customer service and smooth sales operations. As a key leader in our digital sales channels, you will oversee team performance, mentor advisors, and drive operational excellence. You'll combine hands-on involvement in customer support with strategic team leadership, ensuring your team delivers first-class customer experiences and achieves ambitious sales targets. You will manage virtual test drive operations, oversee fleet management for remote test drives, and supervise the coordination with virtual sales teams and local locations. Additionally, you'll be responsible for managing administrative processes related to vehicle orders, including cancellations, exports, and quality assurance. Your leadership will set the tone for a structured, customer-centric approach across all team members.We offer:

- Career Development: Leadership development programs, management training, and clear advancement opportunities 
- Inspiring Culture: Work in an innovative environment where teamwork, passion, and sustainability drive our mission 
- Innovative Projects: Contribute to groundbreaking projects shaping the future of automotive and renewable energy 
- Competitive Benefits: Competitive salary package including Tesla shares/cash award, corporate benefits program, 30 days vacation, 13th month salary, company pension options, and Germany ticket allowance 
- Engaged Team: Be part of a motivated, collaborative team committed to excellence and sustainable impact Tesla is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment are based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, national origin, disability, gender, sexual orientation, or any other protected status. 

What You’ll Do

Team Leadership & Development: 

- Lead, mentor, and develop a team of Inside Sales Advisors, providing regular feedback, coaching, and performance management 
- Conduct performance reviews, identify training needs, and support career development for team members 
- Foster a positive, collaborative team culture that drives engagement and retention 
- Set clear performance expectations and hold team members accountable to individual and collective sales targets Customer Care & Operations Management: 
- Oversee all customer inquiries across virtual channels (calls, emails, SMS, chat, virtual consultations) and ensure timely, professional responses 
- Monitor team performance in customer service delivery and de-escalation of critical inquiries 
- Manage and optimize fleet operations for remote test drives, including location schedules, vehicle availability, and incident response 
- Ensure compliance with company standards and processes across all customer interactions Vehicle Order & Process Management: 
- Review and approve vehicle order cancellations for the German market, ensuring legal compliance and proper refund processing 
- Oversee VAT-free and export order processing, coordinating with internal teams and external partners 
- Manage request processing from the website (test drives, recall requests, trade-ins) and support local locations as needed 
- Ensure quality control and accuracy in all administrative processes Sales & Campaign Management: 
- Oversee the initial approach to all web sales opportunities in Germany, ensuring team members make professional first contacts and advance leads effectively 
- Support event sales opportunities and coordinate team involvement in event activations 
- Lead targeted call campaigns focused on lease renewals, guiding team strategy and performance 
- Monitor conversion rates, lead quality, and sales pipeline metrics Process Improvement & Reporting: 
- Identify operational inefficiencies and implement improvements to enhance team productivity and customer satisfaction 
- Generate and analyze performance reports, providing insights to senior management 
- Ensure team compliance with all company policies, procedures, and legal requirements 

What You’ll Bring

Professional Experience: 

- Proven experience in inside sales, sales support, or team leadership roles in a digital sales environment 
- Demonstrated success managing and developing teams in fast-paced, target-driven environments 
- Strong understanding of sales processes, customer support operations, and performance metrics Leadership & Communication: 
- Excellent communication skills in both German and English, capable of professional interactions with international stakeholders 
- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust and motivate team members 
- Ability to communicate clearly with all levels of the organization Organizational & Strategic Skills: 
- Exceptional organizational abilities with strong prioritization and time management skills 
- Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously without compromising quality 
- Strategic thinking combined with strong execution and attention to detail Problem-Solving & Initiative: 
- Proactive approach to identifying and resolving operational challenges 
- High level of problem-solving ability and service orientation 
- Ability to drive continuous improvement and implement process enhancements Technical Proficiency: 
- Proficiency with CRM tools and digital systems 
- Comfortable working in a technology-driven environment and learning new tools quickly Flexibility & Teamwork: 
- Ability to work shifts, including weekends and early/late shifts (Monday-Saturday, 8am-7pm) as needed 
- Collaborative approach to working with cross-functional teams and stakeholders 
- Adaptability in a dynamic, evolving business environment

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

What to Expect

Tesla is seeking an Account Manager for residential energy sales for Germany. Your core responsibility is B2B sales of Tesla residential and small commercial energy products in Germany, with the focus of selling our Powerwall product, a home battery designed to store energy from solar and/or the grid. You will develop, maintain, and grow a productive customer network, such as distributors and 3rd party installers. In addition, you will actively drive business development opportunities in your region. We are looking for an experienced commercial professional with working experience in the PV or energy storage industry.  In addition to a strong work ethic and a team-oriented personality, successful team members exhibit creativity, passion, and a drive to pioneer advancements in an ever-evolving technological and market landscape.

What You’ll Do

- Achieve Powerwall and Wall Connector sales targets within assigned channel(s) in Germany 
- Build and maintain relationships across the organization of partner accounts effectively communicating Tesla's product and feature roadmap. 
- Evaluate new business opportunities with current and new accounts and/or sales channels, identify suitable product offerings, and take ownership of capturing these opportunities 
- Deliver key market insights into the broader business team 
- Provide sales forecasts to business and manufacturing teams,  
- Support evaluating market dynamics across sectors (utility, commercial & industrial, residential, etc.) and drivers (policy/regulatory, economics, etc.)  
- Represent Tesla at sales and marketing events promoting Powerwall 
- Help identify and support implementation of initiatives to maintain or improve partner training, partner installation quality, and to improve Tesla operations and fulfilment and Tesla support 
- Provide user / customer feedback to IT development teams regarding Tesla tools, systems and to Operations regarding processes 

What You’ll Bring

- 5+ years of work experience in an account management/channel sales role within the PV, energy storage industry
- Excellent communication and documentation skills 
- Ability to prioritize work and execute many projects and tasks in parallel 
- Working knowledge of grid/utility markets, as well as grid-tied technologies 
- Fluency in English and German  
- Flexibility to travel

BERNER pushing the limits – for those who dare more
Making a choice about your career and your employer is a choice about your future - a future where you will invest your passion and a large portion of your time, energy, and capacity.  

YOUR TASKS

- Act as an operations expert within the International Key Account Management team, supporting tenders, strategic and operational improvement projects, as well as controlling and management reporting.
- Provide insights from regular KAM analytics by identifying improvement opportunities and driving the further development of the analytics framework.
- Prepare and continuously improve reports, presentations, customer overviews, and management-ready documentation for international key account topics.
- Coordinate responses to international tenders with Central Departments and relevant Countries, including product matching, pricing, and documentation processes.
- Interact directly with customers, especially within existing relationships, to provide all required information and ensure efficient processes and high-quality service.
- Drive and participate in improvement projects for the KAM community, ranging from process enhancements and new tools to specific strategies for Divisions and Segments.
- Act as a link between Country Key Account Organizations and Corporate Departments, especially Pricing, Supply Chain, Purchasing, ESG, and Product Management.
- Support the professionalization of Country Organizations by coaching them in best-in-class KAM Back-Office Processes, Data Maintenance, and Tender Response Management.

YOUR PROFILE

- Successfully completed university studies, preferably with a Bachelor's Degree or higher in Business Administration, International Management, or a comparable field.
- Relevant experience in Sales Operations, Key Account Operations, Commercial Support, Project Coordination, or a comparable international business function.
- Good understanding of international sales processes, customer structures, and cross-functional collaboration in a complex business environment.
- Strong coordination skills with the ability to structure topics, proactively follow up, and independently manage multiple priorities.
- Very good knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel and PowerPoint; experience with CRM, ERP, or Reporting Systems is an advantage.
- Structured, accurate, and proactive working style with a strong sense of ownership, business orientation, and service mindset.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate data and complex information into clear insights and decision-relevant documents.
- Fluent English skills and proficiency in at least one additional language, both written and spoken.

WHY BERNER?

- Job bike leasing (JobRad)
- Commuting allowance
- Wellpass membership & corporate benefits
- Company pension scheme
- Opportunities for further training
- Technically modern equipped workplace

Apply Now – We’re Excited to Meet You!

Please submit your application via our online form, including your availability and salary expectations.

The BERNER Group is a European trading company serving professionals in the mobility, construction, and industrial sectors. We are the leading B2B specialist and an innovative manufacturer of chemical products. Our purpose is:

“We are pushing the limits of the possible for the shapers of a better tomorrow.”
With our strong brands - BERNER, BTI by BERNER, and CCS - we empower our customers to keep their businesses running successfully.

Join our team and shape the future with us!

The BERNER Group as employer, dare to differentiate ourselves and provide every employee the opportunity to and enable them to dare to be more.  Together, we push our own limits and contribute to shape a better tomorrow.

We are Körber - an international technology group with around 13,000 employees at over 100 locations worldwide and a common goal: We turn entrepreneurial thinking into customer success and shape the technological change. In the Business Areas Digital, Pharma, Supply Chain, and Technologies, we offer products, solutions and services that inspire. We act fast to customer needs, we execute ideas seamlessly, and with our innovations we create added value for our customers. In doing so, we are increasingly building on ecosystems that solve the challenges of today and tomorrow. Körber AG is the holding company of the Körber Group.
Your role in our team

You will be part of the cross-functional product management team which is responsible for all machines and digital products from Körber Pharma Inspection. You should have the ability to strategically collaborate and align with technical and non-technical stakeholders, experience in translating customer needs into technical product requirements and working with our engineering to build and deliver world-class products.

- Act as a voice of product to the customer and as the voice of the customer to product development
- Monitor, analyse and report on end-user feedback and manage evolution of the product in the marketplace
- Ensure user friendliness of the product functionalities

Your profile

- University degree with a technical or scientific focus or comparable work qualification
- 5+ years of experience in shaping highly complex software or data driven products as a product manager or owner
- Fluency in German is preferred, strong English communication required. Further language skills are a plus
- Experience in agile software development methodology (i.e. Scrum, Kanban) and use of agile software development productivity tools (i.e. JIRA, Confluence)
- Proven experience in leading cross-functional projects within a matrix organisation, as well as strong skills in team motivation and goal orientation
- Strategic and analytical mindset with long term vision for the product
- Strong customer-oriented thinking
- Capability to juggle many competing priorities and deadlines
- Ability to see opportunities and possibilities where others see barriers and constraints
- Familiarity with user stories, acceptance criteria and the definition of done
- Previous working experience in consumer health and/or the pharmaceutical industry is a plus
- Willingness to travel sporadically

Körber with benefits

- An open, collaborative, and international working environment
- A future-proof and resilient industry backed by more than 125 years of company success
- Flexible working hours and flexitime arrangements
- Opportunities for mobile working and remote work abroad
- Group-wide career development and continuous learning opportunities

- EGYM Wellpass with a generous employer subsidy

Your working environment

For more than 125 years, high-quality machinery for the pharmaceutical industry has been manufactured at Körber's site in Markt Schwaben. We develop innovative inspection technologies and automation solutions for controlling complex manufacturing and packaging lines for pharmaceutical products. As part of our team, you will help ensure the quality-assured production of inspection machines for pharmaceuticals. Would you like to get a first impression of our Markt Schwaben site and meet your future colleagues virtually? Explore our Xperience here.

What to Expect

At Tesla Engineering Germany in Freiburg, we’re building the future of sustainable energy by developing innovative power electronics for energy storage and vehicle charging systems. Join our team to collaborate across different engineering areas, solve meaningful challenges creatively, and transfer concepts from initial design, through prototyping and testing into real-world solutions.This is an opportunity to support key projects, use modern tools, and work in state-of-the-art facilities to create technologies that shape how energy systems evolve. You get to work on advancing power electronics used for Tesla products globally, thereby directly contributing to the acceleration of the world's transition to sustainable energy.

What You’ll Do

- Deliver clear-to-build status, material coverage, run-out reports, and other analyses as needed to plan engineering builds
- Collaborate with suppliers during design meetings to monitor designed components, evaluate their complexity, and ensure supply chain considerations are addressed early
- Act as the primary interface with suppliers on delivery status, issues, and resolution
- Escalate to commercial or technical partners when required (procurement, accounts payable, quality, engineering, etc.)
- Drive commercial cost negotiations with suppliers to ensure Tesla receives the best possible pricing and leverage cost models and analysis of current market conditions
- Monitor current market conditions and technology roadmaps to proactively identify and address any supply challenges and to determine future business opportunities
- Document component cost and work with Finance to track BOM cost in different program phases

What You’ll Bring

- At least 2 years’ experience in material sourcing, manufacturing, finance, or supply chain management
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in supply chain, Electrical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or similar discipline
- Knowledge of Material Requirements Planning / Enterprise Resource Planning ( MRP/ERP) with a solid understanding of discrete prototype manufacturing, bills of material, product lifecycle management, procure to pay processes and supply chain operations
- Proven experience in the management of high volume engineering builds
- Demonstrated understanding of product release cycle as it relates to the creation and change management of parts and BOM structures
- Ability to prioritize with a high sense of urgency, adapt to a fast-paced/dynamic environment, and act as a self-starter with strong attention to detail and ownership
- Business level fluency in English, German language skills are a plus

jobs.description:
What to Expect

What To ExpectYou will be an integral part of the Materials Engineering organization,
delivering new materials and manufacturing processes that revolutionize Tesla's
products to build a world of amazing abundance. As a Materials Engineer, you
will support the design, validation and implementation of new thermoplastic and
composite materials. Partnering with cross-functional teams, you'll enable
validation, resolve critical issues, and push continuous improvement forward.
This is a 1-year fixed-term contract at Tesla Engineering Germany GmbH and based
in Berlin, Germany.

What You’ll Do

- Develop and prototype new thermoplastic and composite materials and processing strategies to enable future vehicle designs with lower manufacturing costs and improved quality.
- Provide direction to Design Engineers for optimal materials and processes selection by challenging the requirements.
- Generate, interpret, and summarize materials test data using relevant characterization tools (e.g. FTIR, DSC, TGA, DMA, rheometry, mechanical testing, environmental aging) and create links between processing, structure, and properties to inform engineering design decisions.
- Develop or edit specifications and test procedures to define procurement and manufacturing quality standards, including acceptance criteria.
- Support different stakeholders to drive issue resolution.

What You’ll Bring

- Education in Materials Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science or related field.
- 2+ years’ work experience as a materials engineer or related role.
- Understanding of process-structure-property relationships in polymers and their relevant manufacturing processes (e.g., injection molding, compression molding, extrusion, thermoforming). Familiarity with material modeling or simulation tools (e.g. Moldflow, Sigmasoft, LS-Dyna, ANSYS) is a plus.
- Demonstrated hands-on experience in materials characterization and testing with the ability to assess accuracy and limitations is a must. Experience with thermoplastics processing tools (injection molding, thermoforming, etc.) is a plus.
- Ability to effectively handle multiple priorities, organize workload, meet deadlines, and manage time independently.
- Strong communication skills to educate peers, build relationships with suppliers, and support cross-functional collaboration.Please apply with your CV in English.

Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

As Expert Functional Consulting - Logistics & Manufacturing (m/f/d), you will drive the design, governance, and continuous improvement of manufacturing and logistics processes within our global SAP S/4HANA landscape. Acting as the key interface between business stakeholders, IT teams, and service providers, you will ensure operational excellence, business continuity, and high-quality solution delivery.
A key focus of the role is the integration of acquired entities into our global SAP S/4HANA template. You will lead the design of scalable, fit-to-standard Plan-to-Produce and Logistics solutions, ensuring process, data, and testing readiness while enabling fast, business-safe deployments. Through strong governance and functional expertise, you will balance standardization with evolving business requirements and support the continuous optimization of our global manufacturing and logistics capabilities.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Ensure stable and high-quality SAP S/4HANA operations for Plan-to-Produce & Logistic, aligned with SLAs and KPIs
- Lead end-to-end solution design across Production Planning, Manufacturing Execution, and Logistics, aligned with global template standards
- Drive fast onboarding and migration of acquired entities into SAP S/4HANA with minimal business disruption
- Govern external service providers and implementation partners, ensuring delivery quality and accountability
- Ensure integration, master data readiness, and testing quality for deployments and enhancements
- Promote fit-to-standard adoption while managing controlled template enhancements under design authority governance

Show your expertise

5+ years of SAP functional consulting experience with strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA Manufacturing, Logistics, and Plan-to-Produce (P2P) processes
Proven track record in multiple SAP S/4HANA implementations, rollouts, or transformation projects
Deep knowledge of Production Planning (PP), Materials Management (MM), Warehouse Management (WM/EWM), and integration with Procurement and Finance
Strong understanding of MRP, demand and capacity planning, production orders, BOMs, routings, and shopfloor execution
Experience with SAP Fiori, workflows, approval processes, and cross-functional integration scenarios
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in international environments; fluent English required, SAP certification and German language skills are advantageous, with willingness to travel for project deployments and business integration activities
What we offer you

- Your start at Exyte: Take part in a two-day onboarding event with new colleagues
- Attractive location: Our location in Stuttgart features spacious workstations with height-adjustable desks
- Buddy-System: Several weeks of close familiarisation with your colleagues in the team
- Work-life balance: There is always the possibility of switching to mobile working
- Catering: Free coffee specialities as well as water dispensers are accessible on every floor
- Keep fit: Exyte subsidises your fitness contract through EGYM Wellpass at over 5,000 locations in Germany

Contact

You want to be part of the Exyte team? We look forward to receiving your application!
For further questions and information, please do not hesitate to contact Gerd Fleischmann via E-Mail at gerd.fleischmann@exyte.net.

Please note that we only consider applications submitted through our application portal. Applications sent via email will not be considered due to data protection regulations.

What to Expect

Tesla Energy is
deploying the world’s largest fleet of battery energy storage systems (BESS)
from residential Powerwall to grid-scale Megapack, across dozens of markets
worldwide. Regulatory safety certification is the gate between engineering and
the market.

As a Regulatory Safety
Engineer you will be the in-house expert on product safety standards and
market-entry regulations for BESS and supporting power electronics. You will
translate complex normative requirements such as IEC, UL, CSA, EN, and beyond
into engineering design specifications, then drive products through
certification from first design review to certificate issue. You will work
alongside hardware, power electronics, firmware, and systems engineers, making
compliance a design and integral part of the process.

What You’ll Do

- Research and maintain a living map of market-entry requirements for BESS and ancillary equipment across North America, Europe, Australia, and emerging markets; interpret and apply applicable codes, regulations, and directives. 
- Horizon-scan for new and evolving standards affecting BESS products and communicate regulatory risk to engineering and programme leadership. 
- Develop Compliance Product Design Requirements (CPDRs) translating normative requirements into unambiguous engineering specifications, covering product-specific standards (IEC 62619, IEC 62933 series, IEC 62109/62477 series, UL 9540/9540A, UL 1741, UL 1973), and fundamental safety principles such as IEC 60664 series insulation coordination, IEC 60990 touch current, and IEC 60529 IP ratings. 
- Lead design reviews to identify compliance gaps and safety risks early; propose and track engineering solutions to closure. 
- Own CE marking end-to-end: conformity assessment route selection, technical file compilation, Declaration of Conformity (DoC) drafting, and Notified Body or competent authority liaison. 
- Define and manage certification strategies across global schemes such as UL/cUL (NRTL), CB Scheme (IECEE), CE marking, AS/NZS, and others as markets are entered, and author test plans and lead testing in-house and at accredited third-party laboratories. 
- Debug certification failures, root-cause anomalies, and propose design and/or test-method solutions; review test reports and manage certificate lifecycles, surveillance audits, and re-certification triggered by engineering changes. 
- Act as the regulatory safety SME for cross-functional engineering teams; support field compliance escalations and post-market surveillance; build internal knowledge bases and mentor junior engineers on regulatory processes and certification strategy. 

What You’ll Bring

- Degree in Electrical / Electronic Engineering or equivalent; 5+ years in product safety certification for power electronics or energy storage products. 
- Proven CE marking expertise: technical file construction, DoC preparation, and Notified Body liaison; hands-on BESS and power electronics certification experience across IEC and UL standards (IEC 62619, 62933, 62109/62477, UL 9540, UL 1741, UL 1973). 
- Strong ability to interpret complex normative text, resolve ambiguities with laboratories and regulators, and translate requirements into testable engineering specifications. 
- Practical lab experience with power analysers, oscilloscopes, insulation testers, and environmental test chambers; clear written and verbal communication in English.
